test_delete_revisions: test the HFCacheInfo.delete_revisions method to compute a DeleteCacheStrategy for removing specified commit revisions
test_delete_strategy_execute: test the DeleteCacheStrategy.execute method to delete specified blobs, refs, repos, and snapshots from disk
test_try_delete_path: test the _try_delete_path utility function to safely delete files or directories with error logging
